text:
Maria: Quick sync — we need a consistent routing rule for tenant traffic landing in Dedicated pools vs Hosted. Edge is currently ambiguous when both workspace header + VPC endpoint binding exist.
Jonah: Hit this in prod with Acme. They have a VPC endpoint and a reserved pool. Which should win? :thinking: 
Sam: My inclination: workspace header (X-Workspace-ID) should be authoritative for tenant scoping to ensure per-tenant isolation. VPC mapping can be an override only if tenant explicitly opts into network-only private routing. Default: header -> tenant pool; absent header -> consider VPC mapping -> private endpoint -> dedicated pool.
Maria: Agree on default header. Important: if header references a workspace with no dedicated pool, do NOT silently route to another tenant or an unrelated pool. Fallback should be hosted with tightened quotas and an audit event.
Jonah: Telemetry requirement: capture fallback reason (no_pool, pool_full, region_mismatch) with routing decision event, so ops can triage.
Eve: For matcher order I propose: 1) header-scoped routing (signed header check), 2) VPC endpoint CIDR mapping (if tenant flagged), 3) legacy path-based workspace, 4) default hosted. This prioritizes explicit tenant claims while still allowing network-level enforcement.
DevEx-UX: Concern: header-first means proxies or shared gateways can accidentally bypass network-based guarantees. Example: a customer doing canary in a dedicated pool might get routed incorrectly if a request traverses an unexpected IP. Can we make a mode that requires BOTH header + VPC for private routing? :raised_hands:
Sam: Let's support two tenant-config modes: private_routing_mode = "strict" (require both header+VPC or mTLS) and "network_only" (VPC alone suffices). That gives customers control over determinism vs convenience.
Jonah: Also, if we accept header-only routing, we must guard against header spoofing. Options: require signed header (HMAC), or require mTLS on private endpoints. Prefer a small signature scheme: X-Workspace-Sig computed by the customer's edge with a shared key.
Maria: Agreed. Security policy: header-only routing must be accompanied by either mTLS or a verifiable signature. Add this as a hard requirement in the security checklist.
Infra-bot: deployment queued: edge routing matcher update (PR #4321) — window 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Ops: Operational note: quota attribution must follow the final routing decision. If we fallback from dedicated -> hosted due to saturation, billing, quotas, and alerts must reflect hosted usage and notify workspace admins.
Eve: Telemetry payload idea: emit routing.decision events with fields: chosen_target, reason_code, workspace_id (if present), upstream_pool_id; scrub IDs for public dashboards. These events should be high-cardinality for a short retention to debug incidents.
DevEx-UX: Console ask: show a small badge on request traces / rollouts UI when workspace-level routing was applied, link to routing policy config, and surface recent routing fallbacks. This helps customers understand why traffic hit a particular pool.
Jonah: Proposed DSL sketch (for edge config):
```
routing:
  matchers:
    - name: workspace_header
      type: header
      header_name: "X-Workspace-ID"
      signature_header: "X-Workspace-Sig"
    - name: vpc_cidr
      type: source_ip_cidr
      cidrs: ["10.32.0.0/12"]
      requires_flag: "vpc_binding"
    - name: path_workspace
      type: path_prefix
      pattern: "/w/"
  policies:
    - name: strict_private
      requires: ["workspace_header","vpc_cidr"]
    - name: network_only
      requires: ["vpc_cidr"]
  fallback:
    on_no_pool: hosted_with_limited_quota
    emit_event: routing.decision
```
Sam: Tasks: 1) define matcher precedence & policy DSL; 2) implement signature verification lib in edge; 3) wire telemetry event + dashboards; 4) Console UX badge + docs; 5) tests for header spoofing and mTLS flows.
Maria: Assignments: @Jonah take matcher DSL + design doc; @Sam do signature spike and test harness; I'll coordinate telemetry schema and Console changes with @DevEx-UX.
Jonah: I'll open a design doc and link the PR here when ready.
Sam: Spiking signature lib tomorrow and will add unit tests in edge repo.
Maria: Also prepare an incident playbook update for routing-related rollouts (who to page, revert criteria, how to patch bindings). If infra-bot deploy fails, revert and page oncall.
Ops: Adding SLOs for routing decision latency — signature verification should not add >5ms p95.
Infra-bot: deployment started: edge routing matcher update (PR #4321).
Maria: Monitoring now :eyes:
